tasks.subject: Task 1: Refactoriser CryptoService + ExportService
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Remplacer ECIES-P256 par AES-256-GCM dans CryptoService, adapter ExportService::generateEncrypted(), mettre les tests à jour.

**Files:**
- Modify: `app/Services/CryptoService.php`
- Modify: `app/Services/ExportService.php`
- Modify: `tests/Feature/CryptoServiceTest.php`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] generateKey() retourne base64 de 32 bytes
- [ ] encrypt() produit enveloppe v:2
- [ ] decrypt() retrouve le JSON original
- [ ] decrypt() lève exception sur mauvaise clé
- [ ] decrypt() lève exception sur ciphertext altéré

**Verify:** `php artisan test --filter=CryptoServiceTest` → 5 tests, 5 passed

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app/Services/CryptoService.php", "app/Services/ExportService.php", "tests/Feature/CryptoServiceTest.php"], "verifyCommand": "php artisan test --filter=CryptoServiceTest", "acceptanceCriteria": ["generateKey() retourne base64 de 32 bytes", "encrypt() produit enveloppe v:2", "decrypt() retrouve le JSON original", "decrypt() lève exception sur mauvaise clé", "decrypt() lève exception sur ciphertext altéré"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: Adapter KeyTransfer — scanner PHP + QR + tests + vue
